tex_content.html:
Proposition
1. ch3:3-10↗ ex:invariant-metrics-lie-groups In $\mathfrak {su}(2)$ let \[ X=\begin{pmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0 \end{pmatrix},\quad Y=\begin{pmatrix} 0 & i \\ i & 0 \end{pmatrix},\quad Z=\begin{pmatrix} i & 0 \\ 0 & -i \end{pmatrix}. \] For $a>0$, let $g_a$ be the left-invariant metric on $\operatorname {SU}(2)$ for which $X,Y,aZ$ are orthonormal.

  1. The metric $g_a$ is bi-invariant exactly when $a=1$.

  2. The map (3.16) is an isometry from $(S^3,\bar g)$ to $(\operatorname {SU}(2),g_1)$.
